title: Accepting circuit encodings
statement: The language consists of exactly those Boolean strings that encode a pair of a Boolean input list $x$ and a directed acyclic circuit $C$ with one input for each entry of $x$, such that every gate of $C$ has fan-in at most two and evaluating $C$ on $x$ yields true.
